title: Introduce contextual token summaries and seasonal alert suggester
author: Priya Desai
description:
Context and motivation: Customer SLO incidents over the last quarter showed noisy long-tail token latency spikes tied to a mix of kernel contention and prompt-shape drift. Ops wanted: (1) compact per-invocation token summaries that surface which model stage (embed->encode->decode) dominated cost/latency, and (2) guidance for alert thresholds that adapts to weekly/seasonal traffic patterns to reduce alert churn. This PR implements a lightweight pipeline and UI surface for both.

What this PR does (summary): Adds a token-level summary emitter that collates per-invocation token stats into a compact vector (counts, top-3 kernel stages by token-time, tail percentiles) and attaches a stable context-id to traces. Introduces the "Seasonal Alert Suggester" service: a background tuner that ingests rolling windows of the token summaries and recommends per-route alert thresholds (p95/p99 latency and token-cost) using Holt-Winters seasonality detection and robust outlier trimming. Adds a new Grafana dashboard (Token Tail Decomposition by Kernel Stage), a runbook for operators, small runtime enrichers to annotate traces with kernel-tagged telemetry, and unit/integration tests.

Files changed (high-level): observability/dashboards/token_tail_decomposition.json (new dashboard panels + links), runtime/trace/enrichers/kernel_enricher.go (adds kernel-level tags to spans, + opt-in flag), observability/suggester/seasonal_suggester.py (core algorithm + HTTP admin API), observability/emitters/token_summary_emitter.py (aggregator used at edge), docs/runbooks/token-summary-runbook.md, tests/test_seasonal_suggester.py.

Rollout plan and safety: All runtime enrichers are behind a feature flag (ENV: TOKEN_SUMMARY=on). Default is off for Dedicated/Private; hosted will enable in canary region-1 for 48 hours with synthetic replay. The suggester runs in read-only mode by default (admin UI shows suggestions; applying thresholds requires operator confirmation). There are caps to avoid recommending thresholds wider than 3x current SLOs.

Operational impact: Estimated additional telemetry cost is small (~0.5% token-metrics cardinality increase) because summaries are aggregated per-invocation and rate-limited. The dashboard includes a sampling heatmap to understand representativeness. See docs/runbooks/token-summary-runbook.md for mitigation steps if sampling causes gaps.

Backward compatibility: No wire-format changes to public API. Trace/metric enrichment is opt-in. The suggester does not modify alerting rules unless explicitly applied.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation and unit tests - [x] Integration test using synthetic replay - [x] Dashboard panels and screenshots - [x] Runbook draft - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Docs link in PR description

Related: ENG-3421 (long-tail latency RCA), ENG-3499 (alert-churn reduction), pr-241618 (queryable-token-cost-index, referenced for sampling heuristics).

review_comments: Evan Miller: Can we avoid adding high-cardinality labels to the span? Suggest kernel tags be enumerated and kept small — good approach with enums + stable mapping.

Linnea Karlsson: The Holt-Winters approach is fine, but we should fallback to a median-based heuristic if there isn't enough history for a route (cold routes). Add unit tests for <=7 days of data.
Priya Desai: Added unit test for low-history fallback and documented the behavior in the suggester readme.
Samir Rao: Security review — suggester admin API needs auth and audit tags. Make sure applying recommendations is auditable.
Priya Desai: Admin endpoints require bearer admin token; applying a suggested threshold emits an audit event to telemetry.alert_recommendations.audit (documented in runbook).
CI (initial): lint failed on python formatting in suggester. Fixed in c7a9f12.
Evan Miller (approval): Verified dashboard panels in canary, unit tests pass locally, feature-flag gating looks good — approving.
release_notes: Adds token-level contextual summaries and a Seasonal Alert Suggester that recommends adaptive per-route alert thresholds. Includes a new Token Tail Decomposition dashboard, runtime span enrichment (opt-in), and an operator runbook.
notes_for_ops: Enable via TOKEN_SUMMARY feature flag. Run suggester in read-only first; preview suggestions in /admin/alerts/suggestions. Synthetic replay tool available at observability/tools/replay with --token-summary flag.
testing_instructions: 1) Enable TOKEN_SUMMARY in canary region; 2) Run synthetic replay for 1 hour with representative prompt shapes; 3) Verify dashboard panels populate and suggester shows non-empty recommendations; 4) Run tests/test_seasonal_suggester.py locally and in CI
